w10_P4_001253: A 160 000 g cargo pallet is accelerated on a loading ramp at a rate, in m/s², that is 6 more than the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ + 1·x² is itself changing at x = 3. The dock runs 5 identical pallets at once, and the combined force is expressed in kilonewtons. A gravity-assisted slope supplies 11 kN of that force. What force, in kN, must the motors supply?
w10_P4_001254: A warehouse needs the total force, in newtons, to accelerate 6 identical 44 kg crates at once. The acceleration, in m/s², is set by a controller: it takes the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 6, adds 8, subtracts 20, and then doubles the result. The crates all move on the same conveyor belt. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001256: A 5 kg puck is launched on an ice rink at a speed, in m/s, equal to the number of ways to choose 2 players from 12. The rink is 60 m long. A team launches 5 identical pucks at once; the group loses 5 J of its energy of motion to friction and 17 J to a collision with the boards. The drill is repeated 10 times. What is the total energy of motion, in J, over the 10 repeats?
w10_P4_001258: A lab supervisor wants the final figure, in kilojoules, for a demonstration: 2 times the sum of 15 kJ from a heater and the combined energy of motion of 2 identical carts, each expressed in kilojoules. Each cart has a mass of 4 kg. Each cart's speed, in m/s, is the greatest common divisor of 74 and 270. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001259: A depot wants the total force, in kilonewtons, on 3 identical model wagons accelerating at once. Each model wagon has a mass of 156 000 g. The acceleration, in m/s², is 12 times the smaller root of x² - 11x + 24 = 0. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001262: A 128 000 g mining cart is accelerated along a rail at a rate, in m/s², equal to the smaller root of x² - 8x + 15 = 0. The mine runs 10 carts per level and 11 levels at once. A shared coupling adds 4 N to the total. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001269: A 190 000 g grain hopper is accelerated on a rail at a rate, in m/s², equal to the smaller root of x² - 5x + 4 = 0. The hopper holds 2.5 m³. The elevator runs 12 hoppers per line; the line's force is expressed in kilonewtons. The site has 10 lines and the company has 4 sites. What total force, in kN, is required?
w10_P4_001271: A fleet engineer wants the net force, in newtons, on a trolley after a final 21 N push, before which 14 N of drag was subtracted, and before that 11 N of tailwind was added to the force needed to accelerate the trolley. The trolley has a mass of 66 000 g and is 1.4 m long. Its acceleration, in m/s², is the smaller root of x² - 10x + 24 = 0. What is the net force, in N?
w10_P4_001284: A 26 000 g cart moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the greatest common divisor of 146 and 247. The track is 3 m long. A push adds 4 J to the cart's energy of motion, and the result is expressed in kilojoules. The lab runs 4 identical carts, and a heater adds 26 kJ to the total. What is the final energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001289: A harbour engineer is computing the net forward force, in kilonewtons, on a model tug after an 11 kN backward hawser pull is applied. Before that, the forward force is the force needed to accelerate the 125 kg model, plus 8 N from a fan and 13 N from a current, expressed in kilonewtons. The acceleration, in m/s², is the larger root of x² - 13x + 40 = 0. What is the net forward force, in kN, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_001290: A 148 000 g sled is accelerated along a rail at a rate, in m/s², that is 1 less than the area under the curve y = 5x² + 5x from x = 0 to x = 1. The rail is 12 m long. The lab runs 10 identical sleds per bay and 6 bays at once. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001297: A safety consultant reports a final figure, in kilojoules, for a test lane: 10 kJ is added at the end, after 5 kJ is deducted from the combined energy of motion of 12 identical carts, each expressed in kilojoules. Each cart has a mass of 32 kg and is 1 m long. Each cart's speed, in m/s, is the larger root of x² - 13x + 42 = 0. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001304: A 50 000 g crate is accelerated on a conveyor at a rate, in m/s², equal to 9 times the smaller root of x² - 7x + 6 = 0. The conveyor is 15 m long. The plant runs 8 crates per line and 2 lines at once, and a shared drive adds 26 N of belt friction to the total. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001307: A physics teacher wants a final figure, in kilojoules: 2 kJ from a spring, plus the energy of motion of a 42 kg cart expressed in kilojoules. The cart's speed, in m/s, is obtained from a gauge reading by subtracting 30 and then adding 29. The track is 4 m long. The gauge reading is the larger root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001308: A depot wants the force, in kilonewtons, to accelerate a 172 000 g wagon. The wagon is 3 m long. Its acceleration, in m/s², is 9 times a base value, and the base value is the smaller root of x² - 11x + 30 = 0, plus 2, minus 1. What is the force, in kN?
w10_P4_001310: A coach wants the combined energy of motion, in joules, of 4 identical sleds, each having lost 27 J to a brake, after gaining 19 J from a push, after losing 3 J to friction. Each sled has a mass of 49 000 g. Each sled's speed, in m/s, is the larger root of x² - 14x + 48 = 0. What is the combined energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_001315: A range officer wants the total energy of motion, in kilojoules, of 8 identical projectiles, each expressed in kilojoules. Each projectile has a mass of 30 000 g. Its speed, in m/s, is 22 less than the number of ways to choose 2 targets from 14. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ?
w10_P4_001317: A depot wants the total force, in kilonewtons, for 3 lines, each with 3 identical 112 kg carts accelerating at once. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 4x³ - 5x² is itself changing at x = 1. The carts all share one drive. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001318: A lab wants the total energy of motion, in joules, of 6 groups of 3 pairs of identical 16 000 g carts. The track is 2 m long. Each cart's speed, in m/s, equals the area under the curve y = 5x² + 2x from x = 0 to x = 1. What is the total energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_001333: An 8 000 g cart is accelerated on a rail at a rate, in m/s², equal to the greatest common divisor of 35 and 334. The rail is 3 m long. The lab runs 7 identical carts at once, then adds 8 N from a fan and removes 11 N with a brake. What is the net force, in N?
w10_P4_001335: A coach wants the final energy of motion, in joules, of a cart after a 14 J push, before which a 28 J ramp and, earlier, a 3 J nudge added to its energy of motion. The cart has a mass of 41 kg. Its speed, in m/s, is the smaller root of x² - 5x + 4 = 0. What is the final energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_001337: A launcher technician is compiling a final figure, in kilojoules: 4 kJ is deducted at the end, after 15 kJ is added, to the energy of motion of a 5 kg projectile plus 27 J from a booster, expressed in kilojoules. The barrel is 0.8 m long. The projectile's speed, in m/s, is 5 times the sum of 3 and 2. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001340: A foreman wants the total force, in newtons, on 5 identical carts, each with 9 N of fan push added after 17 N of drag is removed from the force needed to accelerate its 94 kg mass. The carts are 1.5 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the number of ways to choose 2 wheels from 6. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001344: A 152 000 g crate is accelerated on a conveyor at a rate, in m/s², that is 19 more than 2 times the smaller root of x² - 9x + 14 = 0. The conveyor is 10 m long. The force for one crate is expressed in kilonewtons, and the plant runs 11 identical conveyors. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001345: A club is compiling the total energy of motion, in kilojoules, of 4 sessions, each with 3 heats of 5 identical model karts, with each session's figure expressed in kilojoules. Each model kart has a mass of 42 000 g. Each kart's speed, in m/s, is the larger root of x² - 7x + 12 = 0. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ?
